name: TractSeg test
summary: Segments white matter bundles from a subject's CSD peaks with TractSeg using user-trained weights from the TractSeg training App, producing one NIfTI mask per bundle.
description: Runs TractSeg inference with custom weights produced by the TractSeg training App. Use it after training TractSeg on your own data; for the standard pretrained model use the original TractSeg App. Needs the CSD peaks of a single subject and the weights/hyperparameter files. Requires a GPU.

inputs.description: CSD peaks of the subject to segment.

citations.text: Wasserthal J, Neher P, Maier-Hein KH. TractSeg - Fast and accurate white matter tract segmentation. NeuroImage 183:239-253 (2018).

failure_modes.fix: Check that the peaks and weights match (same classes and resolution).
